root_audit: The exact Weierstrass extension degree is the sum of ramification times residue degree. The pole identity and conductor exponent one force a dominating section to be a residue double cover of a double tangent line.
The r-order calculation forces f4 divisible by the double-line equation; the displayed degree5 polynomial is the actual anisotropic leading term, and its residue cover is the given H.

The discriminant bounds, the ell=0 cases and the weighted-vertex chart include every possible critical ray; the reducible alternative is an elliptic quartic with a rational line meeting in length two.
The free mu5 character gives rank(T-I)>=8, whereas the exact variation-map bound gives at most3 under the already proved zero intersection form.
The remaining H is the entire exceptional fibre of a normal isolated simple elliptic strict-transform point, with n=a=1.
remaining: The isolated simple elliptic strict-transform point is not excluded by this statement.
